iddialar.iddia: Tablo, Dante'nin İlahi Komedya'sından bir sahneyi betimler; eser Dante ve rehberi Vergilius'un Cehennem'deki yolculuğunu anlatır.
iddialar.alinti: The painting depicts a scene from Dante's Divine Comedy, which narrates a journey through Hell by Dante and his guide Virgil.

iddialar.iddia: Sahnede yazar ve rehberi, iki lanetli ruhun sonsuz bir kavga içinde birbirine dolanmış halini izler.
iddialar.alinti: In the scene the author and his guide are looking on as two damned souls are entwined in eternal combat.

iddialar.alinti: One of the souls is an alchemist and heretic named Capocchio.

iddialar.iddia: Bu tablo, sanatçının Prix de Rome'u kazanma yönündeki üçüncü ve nihayetinde başarısız denemesiydi.
iddialar.alinti: It was Bougereau's third and ultimately unsuccessful attempt to win the coveted Prix de Rome, even though he had submitted a work that he knew would appeal to the judges.

iddialar.alinti: He did however find partial success in his efforts later in the year when Shepherds Find Zenobia on the Banks of the Araxes won the consolation second prize of the year.
